answer: A $20 ripple audit fines fake identities by the square of the batch. One failed check sends three auditors to wander the whole vouch thread. Every agent posts a $30 bond; 5% are drawn each epoch and the auditors verify work logs within 24 hours. A fake triggers the ripple, and each identity caught pays $20 times the square of fakes found, loses its bond, and loses all weight for 10 epochs. 100 clones on one thread cost $20 × 100² = $200,000, while 100 honest agents pay $0 net as bonds return. One loose thread unravels a counterfeit sweater; one bad audit does the same to a clone farm.
